A.name: Stack A: Node-Based Generative Product Visual & Video Studio
A.tagline: ComfyUI runs reproducible Flux/SDXL & video node graphs, Rembg cuts product backgrounds cleanly, MinIO stores S3 assets, imgproxy renders WebP/AVIF ad variants on the fly.

B.name: Stack B: Canvas Inpainting, Headless Video Assembly & Batch DAM
B.tagline: InvokeAI provides an infinite canvas for brand retouching, NCA FFmpeg API stitches 9:16/16:9 product reels, PhotoPrism indexes generated shoots, n8n automates SKU batches.

comfyui.name: ComfyUI Node Studio
comfyui.role: Programmable node-graph engine for Flux/SDXL product photography & AI video generation
comfyui.first_run: Load any generated JSON workflow from the Hub or POST directly to /prompt for automated batch rendering.

rembg-api.name: Rembg Cutout API
rembg-api.role: Zero-click AI background removal server & web UI for clean e-commerce product cutouts
rembg-api.first_run: Upload a product photo in the web UI or POST multipart/form-data to /api/remove for transparent PNGs.

minio-assets.name: MinIO Creative Vault
minio-assets.role: Self-hosted S3-compatible asset storage & web console for raw renders and campaign kits
minio-assets.first_run: Console on :6920 (S3 API on :6921). Default login: minioadmin / minioadmin123 (configurable in .env).

imgproxy-cdn.name: imgproxy Ad Resizer
imgproxy-cdn.role: Ultra-fast on-the-fly image resizing, smart cropping, WebP/AVIF & watermark processor
imgproxy-cdn.first_run: Transform any MinIO asset URL into 1:1, 9:16, or 16:9 ad creatives via /insecure/rs:fill:1080:1080/plain/<url>.

invokeai.name: InvokeAI Infinite Canvas
invokeai.role: Interactive generative canvas with inpainting, outpainting, ControlNet & brand boards
invokeai.first_run: Open the Unified Canvas to refine product lighting, swap backgrounds, and manage brand LoRAs visually.

nca-video-api.name: NCA FFmpeg Video API
nca-video-api.role: Headless FFmpeg REST API for caption burn-in, reel stitching & 9:16/16:9 reformatting
nca-video-api.first_run: POST JSON jobs from n8n to stitch ComfyUI clips, burn subtitles, and normalize audio into ad-ready MP4s.

photoprism-dam.name: PhotoPrism Visual DAM
photoprism-dam.role: AI-tagged digital asset library for reviewing, approving & searching generated product shoots
photoprism-dam.first_run: Local login: admin / admin12345 (set in .env). Browse, tag, and share client-approved creative galleries.

n8n-creative.name: n8n Creative Orchestrator
n8n-creative.role: Automated SKU-to-Ad pipeline wiring ComfyUI, Rembg, FFmpeg Video API & MinIO storage
n8n-creative.first_run: Import /automations/stack_a_comfyui_product_batch.n8n.json to turn product briefs into ready ad packs.
